cc:Work.dc:title: Memory for 1 million concurrent tasks
cc:Work.dc:description: Peak memory in MB for 1 million concurrent tasks. Rust tokio: 214; C#: 461; Node.JS: 494; Rust async-std: 528; Java virtual threads: 1154; Python: 2232; Go: 2658; Elixir: 4009. Labels rounded to whole MB; bar lengths use original measurements. Linear scale from 0 to 4500 MB. Source: https://pkolaczk.github.io/memory-consumption-of-async/
